company.shortDescription: Pairio provides AI-powered maintenance software that helps industrial teams document work, search technical documents, and analyze data.
company.description: Pairio develops AI-powered software for industrial maintenance teams. The platform provides an assistant that guides technicians through troubleshooting by using voice, photos, and videos captured at the machine. Pairio searches across technical documentation and historical maintenance records to return relevant instructions and references. It generates structured maintenance reports automatically from field input so work is consistently documented and knowledge is retained. The software also analyzes maintenance data to uncover patterns and support optimization of service intervals. In addition, Pairio creates work instructions and training materials from recorded procedures and integrates with common ERP and document management systems. Its tools are designed for organizations that operate their own maintenance teams in machinery, production, and plant operations.
